items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee discusses Tommy and Jimmy White's relationship with each other ('Tommy and Jimmy. They didn't get along...') and mentions Tommy joined Father Divine's church, but does not describe a direct personal or professional relationship between Happy Caldwell and Tommy.

ctx.x: That's his uncle. We made those records in 1926, first orthophonic recordings, electrical recordings. Tommy -- later on, around about the early '30's, about the middle '30's, he joined Father Divine's church.
Oh, I wondered what happened to him.
